### Documents rendered once, for every project

`RenderedOnce` · `src/product.ts:15`

What the views of a graph say is written for people by one set of renderers, in the language the views speak, with its dates, its lists, its punctuation and the units of its quantities: the same in every place a document is read.

### A graph shown in a page, for every project

`ShownInAPage` · `src/product.ts:23`

The documents of a graph at each date it changes at, in a page a browser opens as it is (an export) or that follows the project as it changes (trame dev): its HTML, its look and its program written once, which each project assembles with its own choices.
